name: Bingo! Mad Angles Achaari Masti
ingredients_raw: CEREALS AND PULSES MIX {RICE GRITS, DEGERMED CORN GRITS, BENGAL GRAM GRITS AND PEA GRITS}, *EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL AND SEASONING {SUGAR, #SPICES AND CONDIMENTS, IODIZED SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, ACIDITY REGULATORS (CITRIC ACID, MALIC ACID, TARTARIC ACID), HYDROLYZED VEGETABLE PROTEIN, NATURAL FLAVOURS AND NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND FLAVOUR ENHANCERS (508, 635)}. *TO KNOW THE SPECIFIC TYPE OF OIL USED, MATCH THE SYMBOL (^ OR ^^) WITH THE LAST CHARACTER OF BATCH NUMBER WHEREIN ^ DENOTES REFINED PALMOLEIN AND ^^ DENOTES REFINED RICE BRAN OIL. #USED AS FLAVOURING AGENTS. CONTAINS SOY. MAY CONTAIN MILK, WHEAT, BARLEY.
